items.title: One Month until ExileCon 2026
items.summary: In just a month, on November 7 and 8 NZT, we’ll be hosting ExileCon 2026, where we’ll reveal our latest announcements, host developer talks, feature race finales for both games, and much more! Find out more in this news post.
